perception_quality.winner_selection: Rank passing new-data methods by mean two-seed development macro-road IoU; choose a representative passing seed by development only; replay-only is a continuation control. No heldout selection.

quality_adoption.features: 28 by default; fp34 only if >=.003 development quality improvement and no auxiliary regression >.005
quality_adoption.near_f1_auxiliary: Experimental unless development near-F1 gain >=.005 without quality loss >.002

perception_quality.interpretation: Research acceptance gates, not safety/visibility guarantees; all retention classes/views and conditions reported; opened historical cohorts reserved from this new adaptation.

review.primary: confirmation three roads; supported whole-lane GT>=100pixels; road-wise ceil10%budget
review.probability_interpretation: Research priority scores; empirical coverage/Brier reported. No safety or OOD probability guarantee.
review.next_cycle: Verified GT admission and version-specific g1 refit before another round; current trainer begins at f0 only
review.scope: Mixture acceptance versus an explicit fixed common-priority fallback, not heldout hyperparameter optimization

interpolation.motivation: First completed Random endpoint improved dev but missed pre-existing retention limit. Additional development experiment, registered after that result and before other f1 development outcomes.
interpolation.scope: Same alpha grid for all methods/seeds including continuation control; no heldout selection; no extra training steps. Gates unchanged.
interpolation.reference_scope: Weight interpolation concept only; different model/task/data, no CLIP reproduction or promised benefit.
